entries: FIB Headquarters is the federal building in Pillbox Hill infiltrated during The Bureau Raid.
IAA Headquarters is the neighboring intelligence-agency skyscraper in Downtown Los Santos, part of the FIB-versus-IAA storyline.
Maze Bank Tower is one of Los Santos' most recognizable skyscrapers and a major Downtown landmark.
Galileo Observatory is a hilltop observatory inspired by Griffith Observatory, overlooking Los Santos from the Vinewood Hills area.
Kortz Center is a cultural complex in Pacific Bluffs used prominently in The Wrap Up.
Richards Majestic is the film studio in Backlot City where Michael works with producer Solomon Richards.
Vanilla Unicorn is the Los Santos strip club that Trevor takes control of during the story and later uses as a base.
Grove Street is a cul-de-sac in Davis controlled by the Ballas in GTA V, despite its strong historical association with the Grove Street Families in GTA: San Andreas.
Stab City is a trailer settlement in Blaine County strongly associated with The Lost MC.
O'Neil Ranch is the Grapeseed farm and meth operation of the O'Neil Brothers, attacked by Trevor in Crystal Maze.
La Fuente Blanca is Martin Madrazo's estate on Senora Road and the center of the Madrazo family's local operations.
Premium Deluxe Motorsport is Simeon Yetarian's Los Santos car dealership where Franklin works as a repossession agent early in the story.
Lifeinvader Office is the technology-company headquarters Michael infiltrates during Friend Request.
Vangelico is the luxury jewelry store in Rockford Hills targeted in the Jewel Store Job.

The Families is a large South Los Santos street gang associated with green colors and neighborhoods such as Chamberlain Hills and Strawberry. Franklin and Lamar are tied to the Forum Drive Families set, while the gang has an intense rivalry with the Ballas.
Ballas is a large purple-clad street gang based mainly in Davis and surrounding South Los Santos areas. They are major rivals of the Families and appear in several Franklin/Lamar missions.
Los Santos Vagos is a large yellow-associated Mexican street gang concentrated around Rancho and Cypress Flats. Franklin and Lamar fight Vagos members in Repossession.
Varrios Los Aztecas is a turquoise-associated Mexican gang with activity in northern Rancho and Blaine County. Ortega leads a local faction that clashes with Trevor Philips Enterprises.

Marabunta Grande is a Salvadoran gang associated with El Burro Heights and other parts of Los Santos. They appear in the wider criminal ecosystem but play a smaller story role than the Ballas, Families, or Vagos.
The Lost MC is an outlaw motorcycle club with strong presence in Stab City, Grapeseed, and East Vinewood. Trevor enters a violent war with the club early in his storyline.
O'Neil Brothers is a family-run meth operation based at O'Neil Ranch in Grapeseed. They become Trevor's rivals after the Triads consider doing business with them.
Los Santos Triads is Wei Cheng's Chinese criminal organization. They become enemies of Trevor and later abduct Michael during the story.
Madrazo Cartel is Martin Madrazo's Mexican-American crime organization, based around La Fuente Blanca and involved in drug trafficking and coercion.
Armenian Mob is an Armenian criminal group associated with Simeon Yetarian's circle and criminal activity around La Puerta and the vehicle business.
Korean Mob is a Korean criminal organization associated with Little Seoul and parts of the city's underworld.

Merryweather Security is a private military and security contractor rather than a street gang. It fields heavily armed mercenaries, aircraft, naval assets, and armored vehicles and becomes a major enemy faction.
Federal Investigation Bureau is GTA V's fictional federal law-enforcement agency. Dave Norton and Steve Haines are central FIB figures who manipulate the protagonists.
International Affairs Agency is a fictional federal intelligence agency and rival of the FIB. The agencies compete for influence and funding during the story.
what is Los Santos Police Department
Los Santos Police Department is the main city police force. LSPD responds to crimes in Los Santos and escalates pursuit as the wanted level rises.

Los Santos County Sheriff's Department is the law-enforcement agency commonly encountered in Blaine County and rural parts of San Andreas.
NOOSE is a heavily armed federal tactical response organization that appears at higher wanted levels and during major missions.
Altruist Cult is an isolated cult based in the Chiliad Mountain State Wilderness. Trevor can deliver certain random-event passengers to the camp, eventually triggering a shootout.
Epsilon Program is a cult-like religious organization led by Cris Formage. Michael can follow its lengthy optional mission chain.
Trevor Philips Enterprises is Trevor's Sandy Shores criminal business, focused mainly on weapons and methamphetamine trafficking with associates such as Ron, Wade, and Chef.

There is no single best Story Mode car for every use. For outright top speed, the Truffade Z-Type leads tested Story Mode rankings at about 127 mph, followed closely by the Truffade Adder. For a balanced supercar, the Entity XF or Zentorno are strong choices; for a car you can safely keep upgrading long-term, Franklin's Buffalo S is practical because his signature car respawns.

In tested GTA V Story Mode top-speed rankings, the Truffade Z-Type is the fastest conventional car at about 127 mph (204 km/h), with the Truffade Adder close behind at about 126.25 mph. Exact performance can vary with upgrades, road conditions, and testing method.

For Story Mode supercars, the Adder is excellent for top speed, while the Entity XF and Zentorno are strong all-round choices because they combine high speed with predictable handling. If the question is about lap time, handling, or price, Franklin should ask which criterion matters.
best cheap car gta v story

For a cheap but capable Story Mode car, the Benefactor Schwartzer and Karin Sultan are strong street-found options. Both can be stolen and upgraded rather than bought at supercar prices, making them practical early or mid-game choices.
best off road vehicle gta v story

For Story Mode off-road use, the Canis Mesa, Karin Rebel, and Vapid Sandking are practical choices because of ground clearance and rough-terrain ability. Trevor's Bodhi is also useful because it is his persistent personal vehicle.

For Story Mode motorcycles, the Pegassi Bati 801 is a strong all-round performance bike and is easy to obtain compared with rarer options. High speed on a bike comes with much lower crash protection than a car.

The best Story Mode aircraft depends on purpose: the P-996 LAZER is the strongest combat jet, the Besra is agile for unarmed aerobatics, and helicopters such as the Buzzard are more practical for landing and short trips. The LAZER is difficult to steal safely from Fort Zancudo.

For general Story Mode use, the Buzzard is one of the most useful helicopters because it is compact, agile, and armed. The Frogger is easier for ordinary transport but lacks the Buzzard's combat utility.
best getaway car gta v story

A good Story Mode getaway car should combine acceleration, handling, four seats when needed, armor upgrades, and bulletproof tires. Franklin's Buffalo S is a practical persistent choice; high-performance sedans and sports cars can also work well if they fit the mission's crew requirements.
do bought cars respawn story mode

Story Mode vehicles do not use GTA Online-style insurance. A destroyed purchased or stolen car can be permanently lost. Abandoned recent vehicles may appear at the police impound, but the safest way to keep a car is to store it in a garage and avoid destroying it.
